transcript: Speaker A: tuti futi english se confident english ka safar teen steps mein. Sabse pehle toh aap apne phone mein PW Talk app download kar lo. Number 1. basics clear karo. uske liye PW Talk app par reels jaise chote chote videos hain, jinhe physics wallah ki team ne banaya hai. jab bhi free time mile toh reels ki jagah inhe dekho. bina kisi mehnat ke aapke basics clear ho jayenge. Number 2. practice karo dimag se. nouns, pronouns ya dictionary ka ratta maarne se kabhi bhi english speaking achhi nahi hone wali. PW Talk app par aapko aisi exercises milengi jo aapko real life mein use hone wali english sikhayengi. din mein 10 se 15 minute hi practice karna kaafi hai. Number 3. bolna shuru karo bina dare. zyada se zyada english mein baat karna start karo. lekin doston ke saamne bolne se galti karne ka darr rehta hai. isiliye PW Talk app ke AI teacher ki help le sakte ho jo aapki galtiyon ko judge nahi karenge aur aapko sahi english sikhayenge. toh basics, exercises aur real speaking ki practice teeno ek hi app par kar sakte ho. abhi PW Talk app download kar lo. [Speaker A: Broken English to confident English journey in three steps. First of all, download the PW Talk app on your phone. Number 1. Clear your basics. For that, there are short videos like reels on the PW Talk app, made by the Physics Wallah team. Whenever you get free time, watch these instead of reels. Without any effort, your basics will be cleared. Number 2. Practice with your brain. Rote learning nouns, pronouns, or the dictionary will never make your English speaking good. On the PW Talk app, you will get exercises that teach you English used in real life. Practicing just 10 to 15 minutes a day is enough. Number 3. Start speaking without fear. Start talking in English as much as possible. But speaking in front of friends brings the fear of making mistakes. That's why you can take the help of PW Talk app's AI teacher, who won't judge your mistakes and will teach you correct English. So, basics, exercises, and real speaking practice can all be done on one app. Download the PW Talk app now.]

The ad concludes with a call to action to download the PW Talk app.
